sops.title: SOP-014: Vehicle Theft/Break-in Response
sops.procedure:
1. DO NOT approach the suspect directly.
2. Alert security patrol at ext. 2200 immediately.
3. If suspect is armed or aggressive, call 911.
4. Monitor via camera — maintain visual contact.
5. Note: vehicle description, suspect description, direction of travel.
6. Preserve the scene for law enforcement.
7. File incident report within 1 hour of resolution.

sops.title: SOP-021: School Perimeter Breach Response
sops.procedure:
1. DISPATCH SECURITY IMMEDIATELY — do not delay.
2. Initiate building lockdown protocol.
3. Call 911 — report unauthorized person at school perimeter.
4. Notify school administration (principal + vice principal).
5. Alert all teachers via PA system to lock classroom doors.
6. Monitor suspect via camera — do NOT lose visual.
7. Wait for law enforcement arrival.
8. Do NOT attempt to apprehend the suspect.
9. Document everything for post-incident review.

sops.title: SOP-005: After-Hours Loitering Response
sops.procedure:
1. Observe for 2 minutes to confirm loitering (not just passing through).
2. If confirmed, alert security patrol at ext. 2200.
3. Patrol should approach and ask for identification.
4. If person has valid badge/reason, log as false positive.
5. If person refuses to identify or becomes hostile, call 911.
6. File report with time, description, and camera footage reference.
